title: ClaimConnect Evidence
short_description: Record vehicle incidents offline and build PDF evidence packs you control.
full_description:
ClaimConnect helps you record a vehicle incident while the details are fresh, then turn it into a clear PDF evidence pack.

HOW IT WORKS
- Confirm everyone is safe, then start a guided record: vehicle, driver, date and time, location, people involved.
- Add up to 10 photographs with captions. Originals are hashed and kept unchanged.
- Autosave protects your draft if you are interrupted. Reopen it at any time.
- Review everything, generate the PDF, then preview, save or share it yourself.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Everything stays encrypted on your device. No account, no servers, no analytics.
- Nothing leaves the app until you choose to share or save it.
- Capture and PDF work fully offline; only map snapshots and AI checks use the internet.

PLEASE NOTE
ClaimConnect organises information you supply. It does not submit insurance claims, decide fault, or verify evidence. Optional AI checks are clearly labelled suggestions and never alter your original record. AI checks include a free monthly allowance; unlimited checks are a one-time in-app purchase. Call emergency services first when anyone may be hurt.

EMERGENCY NUMBERS
Standard emergency numbers adapt to your country (United Kingdom, United States, Germany, France and Spain, with 112 elsewhere). You can also store personal breakdown or family contacts.
whats_new: Initial release: guided incident capture, photo evidence with captions, autosave drafts, and PDF evidence packs with preview, save and share.
